limitations: Worker/decision/gate rows are coordinator checkpoints, not live process discovery.
A recent emission does not establish recent source review; table checkpoint dates and linked source receipts remain authoritative.
Live telemetry omits bodies and allowlists attributes; correlation identifiers remain in private local storage.
Generation replacement is native query behavior, not a claim of transactional multi-stream Loki ingestion.
Same-host Linux/WSL timer depends on active user manager/backends; Mac and always-on remote hosting unaccepted.
Display rounds currency/percent fields to two decimals; exact simulation results remain in source receipt.
No financial execution, exact-once audit, full monitoring coverage or causal token savings established.
Recorded worker/decision state is not a live process registry.
No broker execution, exact-once accounting, universal coverage or net token savings.
claim: Native local dashboard displays current-generation public research checkpoints with live service/usage telemetry; generation deletion/readdition, timer and browser acceptance retained.
